How this row's coding was quality-checked: either a sample spot-check (original 41 papers -- 3 papers independently re-verified across ~9 claims, all confirmed) or a per-paper adversarial verify pass (papers_second_batch -- every paper's model_family, Q4a, Q4b, U2, V1 and eligibility_notes independently re-checked against the source PDF by a second reviewer-agent, with corrections applied where discrepancies were found).
yes / no / partial (partial = does something in this direction but incompletely) / unclear (paper is ambiguous) / n/a (question does not apply, e.g. Q2a-b for unconditional models).
Green = yes / quantified; Red = no; Yellow = partial / visual overlay; Grey = unclear / n/a.

The protocol is architecture-agnostic by design: every check (W1 on functionals, real-vs-real floors, coverage/density, NN-distance memorization, C2ST) operates only on the generated SAMPLES and never inspects the model's training objective or requires a tractable likelihood. GAN/VAE papers are coded identically to diffusion papers, with no field forced to "n/a" for architecture reasons. The one genuine dependency is that Q2b (calibration) and Q4a (diversity) require the model to actually be RUN in sampling mode (multiple draws) -- true for GANs and diffusion models alike, and tracked as a finding (how often papers of each model class actually exploit stochasticity), not an eligibility criterion.
Human-coded strength of the strongest count/transform-matched non-generated downstream baseline; vocabulary and decision rules must be frozen before coding.
Required full-corpus verification status for memorization, real-reference, downstream-utility, and metric-validity fields.
